children: Root overhauled its strategic relationship with Carvana by canceling all outstanding 2021 warrants and issuing a new Common Stock Purchase Warrant for up to 1,525,560 shares across five milestone-based tranches. Alongside the warrant exchange, the parties amended their Commercial Agreement to update term, non-renewal, warrant definitions and exclusivity, and also amended the Investment and Registration Rights Agreements to align with the new warrant. The moves aim to better link equity incentives to performance on the integrated insurance platform and streamline governing documents.
